Name: Jehu, Son of Hanani
Summary: Jehu the son of Hanani brought the LORD's word against Baasha, that his house would be made like Jeroboam's, because he walked in Jeroboam's sins after God raised him from the dust.
RelatedPeople: Baasha, King of Israel; Hanani, Father of Jehu the Prophet; Hanani, the Seer; King Jehoshaphat
LifeLesson: The prophet who judges one dynasty is not spared the duty of judging the next.
